messages.text: Small steps every day add up to big results.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
messages.author: Seneca

messages.text: The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now.
You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
messages.author: James Clear

messages.text: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
messages.author: Confucius

messages.text: What you do today can improve all your tomorrows.
messages.author: Ralph Marston

messages.text: You kept going on the hard days. That counts.
Look how far you have come this year.
You showed up today, even when it wasn't easy.
